GOVERNMENT OF RAJASTHAN
OFFICE OF THE TEHSILDAR, JAIPUR
CASTE CERTIFICATE
Certificate No: ST/2024/09876
Date: 15/06/2024

This is to certify that RAMESH KUMAR MEENA, son of SHRI RAMESHWAR MEENA, resident of Village Rampura, Tehsil Bassi, District Jaipur in the State of Rajasthan belongs to the MEENA community which is recognized as a Scheduled Tribe under the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950.

Competent Authority: TEHSILDAR, JAIPUR
